text:
El-Sayed Denounced ‘Conservatives’ for Opposing Free Sex Changes for Transgender Illegal Immigrants, Called for Universal Health Care for Trans ‘Undocumented Persons’ | Chuck Ross, Washington Free Beacon

Abdul El-Sayed, in a series of unearthed podcast remarks, called for a "truly inclusive" universal health care entitlement that would include "care for transgender people" and "care for immigrants." He later criticized conservatives for demonizing "the undocumented person who comes to this country and wants to get gender reassignment surgery on Medicare for All."

Transgender immigrants seeking government-funded gender treatments, he said, were the "prime example" that conservatives would use to turn the public against universal health care, "because it captures a group of multiple marginalized people whom they want to cast as being undeserving."

El-Sayed made the remarks in 2021 and 2022 in podcasts unearthed by the Washington Free Beacon. El-Sayed—who at the time was a former Michigan gubernatorial candidate working as a commentator and podcaster—called for a "truly inclusive" taxpayer-funded universal health care system that provides the "full gamut of health care that any and everyone would need." Such a plan, he said, should include health care for illegal aliens, transgender people, and transgender illegal aliens seeking sex-change procedures.

"When you talk about care for transgender people, when you talk about care for immigrants," El-Sayed said on a Boston University health policy podcast on March 24, 2021, "all of these things are going to be deeply politicized."

"And my hope, right, is that we would pass a Medicare for All that is truly inclusive and offers the full gamut of health care that any and everyone would need," he went on.

El-Sayed, an epidemiologist-turned-politician who wrote a book about Medicare for All, expanded on his utopian vision for the government-run health system on his podcast, America Dissected.

"A lot of the most difficult conversations break on the question of who deserves what care, right?" he said in an episode on Feb. 15, 2022.

"The prime example that conservatives will impose on a conversation about Medicare for All will be ‘Well, what do we do with the undocumented person who comes to this country and wants to get gender reassignment surgery on Medicare for All,’" he said.

Conservatives seeking to demonize transgender illegal immigrants seeking sex change treatments were guilty of "the original sin of racism," he said.

"That’s going to be the example that they’re going to push forward because it captures a group of multiple marginalized people whom they want to cast as being undeserving," El-Sayed said.

It’s the kind of position that helped undermine Kamala Harris’s 2024 presidential campaign. Harris stated in a 2019 questionnaire during her first failed presidential bid that she supported government-funded gender transition care for people in federal custody, including illegal aliens and prisoners, CNN reported.

Republicans hammered Harris with ads asserting the Democrat "is for they/them; President Trump is for you"—a reference to the transgender lobby’s infatuation with so-called preferred pronouns.

El-Sayed embraced other far-left positions during the same era, the height of what his ally Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez—who campaigned with him on Thursday—has dubbed "Woke 1.0."

In 2020, El-Sayed called to defund police departments and suggested in a podcast that police officers should not carry guns.

El-Sayed, who has doubled down on his support for Medicare for All, has suggested the program should cover any medical procedures that a doctor and patient deem necessary. And he has said explicitly that it should cover "gender-affirming care," a euphemism for chemical and surgical sex-change treatments for both adults and children.

"I believe that Medicare for All should cover all health care, which is defined by what a patient needs in accordance with their doctor," he said this year, "so that includes reproductive rights, that includes gender-affirming care."

And El-Sayed’s support for "gender-affirming care" for minors extends to surgeries. In a bizarre exchange with Fox News's Jesse Watters in which the candidate asked the TV anchor whether he is "circumcised" after Watters pressed him on the issue of sex-change-related surgeries for minors.

"Circumcision's different than castration," Watters said.

"Circumcision is surgery on a kid’s ding-a-ling," El-Sayed shot back.

El-Sayed has also defended providing Medicare for All for illegal aliens.

"A lot of folks will get up in arms when you say you want to provide health care for people who are undocumented," he said at a health conference in 2017. He said Medicare for All for illegal aliens "just makes sense because it’s good policy and efficient." He asserted that a failure to cover illegal aliens would lead them to seek health care at emergency rooms and that taxpayers would ultimately foot the bill.

At the same time, El-Sayed broadly opposes efforts to curtail illegal immigration. He has called for abolishing ICE, the agency that handles deportations, and decriminalizing illegal border crossing.

"Abdul wants to guarantee healthcare for every single American taxpayer and believes that medical decisions should be between a patient, their family, and their doctor," said campaign spokesman Cole Wozniak.

text:
“THE WORD WAS GOD” AND “THE WORD BECAME FLESH” — A RESPONSE TO DUSTIN SMITH'S UNITARIAN INTERPRETATION OF JOHN 1 AND HIS DENIAL OF CHRIST'S DEITY IN JOHN AND REVELATION

(1).  John begins, “In the beginning WAS the Word, and the Word was WITH GOD, and the Word WAS GOD” (John 1:1). The Greek reads kai theos ēn ho logos — “and the Word was God.” John distinguishes the Word from the Father while simultaneously identifying the Word as divine. John's argument goes beyond the literary personification of an attribute. He declares that “ALL THINGS were made through Him, and without Him NOTHING was made that was made” (John 1:3). The Word is not placed among created things but on the Creator's side of the Creator-creature distinction.

Compare Isaiah 44:24, where YAHWEH declares, “I am the LORD, who makes ALL THINGS, who stretches out the heavens ALL ALONE, who spreads abroad the earth BY MYSELF.” Yet John declares that absolutely nothing came into existence apart from the Word! I recognize your argument that God creates THROUGH His Word, just as He creates through His wisdom in Proverbs 3:19 and Psalm 33:6. The word “through” alone does not settle whether the Word is personally distinct. But John's subsequent identification of this same Word with the incarnate Son, together with Jesus' own testimony concerning His preexistence, establishes that John is doing far more than describing God's impersonal creative speech.

(2).  John declares, “In Him was LIFE, and the LIFE was the LIGHT of men” (John 1:4). This is especially significant because the OT repeatedly identifies YAHWEH Himself as LIFE and LIGHT! Psalm 36:9 declares, “For with You is the fountain of LIFE; in Your LIGHT we see LIGHT.” Psalm 27:1 declares, “The LORD is my LIGHT and my salvation,” while Deuteronomy 30:20 identifies Yahweh as Israel's LIFE. Yet Jesus declares, “I am the LIGHT of the world” (John 8:12), “I am the resurrection and the LIFE” (John 11:25), and “I am the way, the truth, and the LIFE” (John 14:6). Furthermore, John 5:26 declares, “For as the Father has LIFE IN HIMSELF, so He has granted the Son to have LIFE IN HIMSELF.” Jesus possesses the divine prerogative of giving eternal life and raising the dead (John 5:21–29). These are not merely the characteristics of a wise prophet. John presents Jesus as possessing and communicating the LIFE belonging to Yahweh Himself!

(3).  your interpretation of John 1:14 as Jesus' water baptism creates a serious exegetical problem. John writes, “And the Word BECAME FLESH and DWELT AMONG US, and we beheld His glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father, full of grace and truth.” Notice the deliberate contrast in the Greek. In John 1:1, the Word already “WAS” (ēn) in the beginning. In John 1:3, created things “CAME INTO BEING” (egeneto) through Him. But in John 1:14, the eternal Word “BECAME” (egeneto) flesh. The Word who already existed with God and was God entered human existence. John does not say that the Word entered an already existing human being at His baptism. Nor does he say that the Word became the Spirit or that God's wisdom was merely bestowed upon Jesus. He says the Word BECAME FLESH!

And when John actually discusses Jesus' baptism, he explains its purpose: “that He should be REVEALED TO ISRAEL, therefore I came baptizing with water” (John 1:31). REVEALED, Dustin, not brought into existence, not transformed into flesh, and not made into the Word! John 1:32–34 describes the Spirit descending upon Jesus and remaining upon Him as the sign by which John the Baptist would recognize and identify the Messiah. The baptismal narrative concerns the public revelation and identification of the Son, while John 1:14 concerns the incarnation of the eternal Word. You are conflating two distinct events without textual justification.

(4).  your appeal to Proverbs 8 and personified wisdom does not establish that the Word in John 1 is merely an impersonal attribute. I agree that John draws upon Jewish wisdom traditions and that wisdom is personified in Proverbs 1–9. But identifying literary parallels does not determine everything John intends to communicate about Jesus. The question is whether John develops those traditions to reveal the personal identity of the eternal Son. Proverbs 8 provides important background, but John 1:14 identifies the Word as the One whose glory was beheld in the flesh, while John 1:18 identifies the unique Son who makes the Father known. You cannot simply assume that because wisdom is personified in Proverbs, the Son's personal preexistence in John must also be figurative. That is precisely what you need to demonstrate.

(5).  Jesus' own statements concerning His heavenly origin and preexistence directly challenge your interpretation. In John 6:38, Jesus declares, “For I have COME DOWN FROM HEAVEN, not to do My own will, but the will of Him who SENT ME.” In John 6:62, He asks, “What then if you should see the Son of Man ASCEND WHERE HE WAS BEFORE?” Where was Jesus BEFORE? John doesn't say that an impersonal attribute of wisdom would ascend to heaven. Jesus speaks of the Son of Man returning to where He previously existed! Likewise, in John 8:58, Jesus declares, “Before Abraham was, I AM.” His existence is contrasted with Abraham's coming into being. The statement is consistent with the eternal preexistence introduced in John 1:1.

And John 17:5 makes this even clearer: “And now, O Father, glorify Me together with Yourself, with the glory which I HAD WITH YOU BEFORE THE WORLD WAS.” Notice the personal language: “I HAD WITH YOU.” Jesus doesn't say that God's wisdom possessed glory in some abstract sense. He speaks of glory that HE possessed WITH THE FATHER before the world existed! John 17:24 reinforces this: “You loved ME BEFORE THE FOUNDATION OF THE WORLD.” The Father loved the Son before creation. You interpret these statements through the lens of personified wisdom, but the natural reading is that Jesus is describing His own personal preexistence and relationship with the Father. John 1:1 and John 17:5 interpret one another: the Word was WITH GOD, and Jesus possessed glory WITH THE FATHER before the world existed.

(6).  you appeal to John 17:3, where Jesus addresses the Father as “the ONLY TRUE GOD,” as though this excludes the deity of the Son. But Trinitarian theology has never denied that the Father is the only true God! The question is whether the Son shares the one divine nature while remaining personally distinct from the Father. In the very same prayer, Jesus speaks of the glory He possessed with the Father before creation (John 17:5). And in John 5:23, Jesus declares that ALL should “HONOR THE SON JUST AS THEY HONOR THE FATHER.” Why should a merely human Messiah receive the same honor given to the Father? The distinction between the Father and Son does not establish that the Son is a creature. John teaches both their personal distinction and the Son's participation in divine glory, life, and honor.

(7).  your claim that John does not identify Jesus as God encounters an especially serious problem in John 20:28. Thomas addresses the resurrected Jesus directly: “MY LORD AND MY GOD!” The Greek reads ho kyrios mou kai ho theos mou. Thomas is not speaking to the Father while looking at Jesus. John explicitly states that Thomas “said TO HIM,” referring to Jesus. Nor does Jesus rebuke Thomas for blasphemy. Instead, He responds, “Because you have seen Me, you have believed” (John 20:29). John begins his Gospel declaring that the Word WAS GOD (John 1:1), and near its conclusion Thomas confesses Jesus as MY GOD (John 20:28). This correspondence is central to John's presentation of Christ. John 20:31 then declares that these things were written so that readers might believe Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God. But that purpose statement does not cancel everything John has already revealed concerning the divine identity of that Son! It identifies the very Jesus whose eternal existence, divine works, glory, and identity John has spent his Gospel explaining.

(8). your claim that John does not teach the Trinity confuses the absence of later theological terminology with the absence of its biblical foundation. In John 14:16–17, Jesus declares that He will ask the Father to give His disciples “ANOTHER HELPER,” the Spirit of truth. In John 15:26, Jesus distinguishes Himself from the Father and the Spirit who proceeds from the Father and testifies concerning Him. John 16:13–15 describes the Spirit hearing, speaking, guiding, and glorifying the Son. John does not use the later theological term “Trinity,” but he clearly distinguishes the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. Combined with the Son's deity and the personal activity attributed to the Spirit, these passages provide essential foundations for the doctrine. You may dispute the Trinitarian interpretation of these texts, but you cannot simply dismiss it as something foreign to John's writings.

In John 14:1-3, when Jesus would come in His parousia in AD 70, He and the Father would make their home within the believer and it would require faith that it had happened (vss. 23, 29).  This is Paul's "Christ in you the hope of glory" or Jesus elsewhere instructing that when He would be revealed from heaven in AD 70 He would establish His kingdom "within" a person (Luke 17:20-37 / Luke 21:27-32).  John develops this more in Revelation 21-22.  When Christ came "soon" in AD 70 He and the Father make their presence or dwelling within the Church or the New Jerusalem.  God / Jesus is with and dwells within man and His Church.  The temple imagery in John 14 and Revelation 21:16 is pretty clear.  

(9). Revelation reinforces John's identification of Jesus with Yahweh! In Isaiah 44:6, Yahweh declares, “I AM THE FIRST AND I AM THE LAST; BESIDES ME THERE IS NO GOD.” Isaiah 48:12 repeats this exclusive divine title. Yet in Revelation 1:17–18, the risen Jesus declares, “I AM THE FIRST AND THE LAST. I am He who LIVES, and WAS DEAD, and behold, I am ALIVE FOREVERMORE.” The One who died and rose again identifies Himself with the divine title belonging to Yahweh! This is not merely a prophet speaking God's words. Jesus personally claims the title of the eternal God.

Furthermore, Isaiah 60:19–20 declares that YAHWEH will be the EVERLASTING LIGHT of His redeemed people. Yet Revelation 21:23 declares that the glory of God illuminates the New Jerusalem and “THE LAMB IS ITS LIGHT.” Revelation 22:1–3 describes the river of LIFE proceeding from “THE THRONE OF GOD AND OF THE LAMB.” There is ONE throne associated with God and the Lamb, and the Lamb participates in the divine reign and glory. John is deliberately drawing upon the Old Testament's descriptions of Yahweh to identify the divine status of Jesus Christ.

And consider Revelation 5:13–14, where EVERY CREATURE in heaven, on earth, under the earth, and in the sea offers blessing, honor, glory, and power “TO HIM WHO SITS ON THE THRONE, AND TO THE LAMB, FOREVER AND EVER!” The Lamb receives the same universal heavenly praise directed toward God Himself. If Jesus is merely a human being empowered by God's wisdom, why is He distinguished from the universal chorus of creation and included alongside God as the recipient of its worship? Revelation does not merely present Jesus as an authorized human messenger. It includes Him in the worship and glory belonging to the one Creator!

Dustin, literary parallels are not sufficient to overturn John's explicit statements concerning Christ's identity. The existence of personified wisdom in Proverbs does not prove that Jesus' heavenly preexistence is merely figurative. Nor does Jesus' baptismal anointing establish that the Word became flesh at His baptism. John 1:31 identifies the baptism as the occasion for REVEALING Jesus to Israel, while John 1:14 identifies the incarnation of the eternal Word.

The question is not whether John uses the later creedal terminology of the Trinity. The question is whether John identifies Jesus as personally preexistent, truly divine, distinct from the Father, and sharing the divine titles, glory, works, life, and worship belonging to Yahweh. The answer is YES!

John begins with “THE WORD WAS GOD” (John 1:1), identifies the incarnation of that eternal Word (John 1:14), records Jesus' testimony concerning His preexistent glory with the Father (John 17:5), and brings his Gospel to its climactic confession, “MY LORD AND MY GOD!” (John 20:28). Revelation then identifies the risen Christ as “THE FIRST AND THE LAST” and includes the Lamb in the heavenly worship directed to God Himself.

Your Unitarian interpretation must explain all of these passages together. Simply appealing to personified wisdom and relocating John 1:14 to Jesus' baptism does not adequately account for John's consistent testimony that the eternal divine Word became flesh in Jesus Christ.

*Dustin, I asked you some questions you have not responded to which I will pick up as #10... @OneGodPodcast @maklelan @joeroganhq @joerogan @WesleyLHuff @HwsEleutheroi

text:
WE HAVE PRAYED OVER ENOUGH GRAVES. IT IS TIME TO PROTECT THE LIVING. ✝️⚔️

How many more Christian families must be slaughtered before the world does more than offer condolences? How many churches must burn? How many mothers must bury their children? How many innocent souls must cry out before humanity answers?

Since 2009, Intersociety estimates that approximately 125,000 Christians have been killed in Nigeria and more than 19,000 churches attacked, destroyed or forced to close. It also estimates over 7,000 Christians killed and 7,800 abducted in its 2025 reporting period. These estimates are disputed, but the suffering is undeniable. In Nigeria, Congo and beyond, innocent families are being terrorized and driven from their homes.

AND WHAT DO WE DO?

We pray. We express outrage. Then we put down our phones, embrace our families and return to the comfort of our lives.

But what of the child whose parents were murdered? The mother whose daughter was abducted? The priest who fears his congregation may not survive another Sunday?

THEY CANNOT WALK AWAY FROM THIS NIGHTMARE. WHY SHOULD OUR CONSCIENCE BE ALLOWED TO?

I am a Catholic. I believe in prayer with every fiber of my being. But the hands we fold in prayer were also created to lift the fallen, shelter the helpless and defend the innocent.

Christ commanded us to love our neighbors, care for the least among us and carry our Cross.

THE CROSS IS NOT AN ORNAMENT OF CONVENIENCE. IT IS A CALL TO SACRIFICE!

Let me be clear: Our enemy is not the peaceful Muslim raising a family. Innocent Muslims are also murdered by extremists. Our enemy is the terrorist and the persecutor who destroys innocent life. We seek protection, not vengeance. Justice, not hatred. Peace, not conquest.

To His Holiness, Pope Leo XIV, @Pontifex: I appeal to you as a Catholic and a Knight sworn before Almighty God. I ask the Holy See to open dialogue with the Sovereign Military Order of the Temple of Jerusalem, so we may serve alongside the Church, local communities and humanitarian organizations in lawful missions of mercy, relief and protection.

The Knights Templar once protected those traveling into danger. Today, families are trapped within that danger, praying someone will come to their aid.

HOLY FATHER, LET US HELP CARRY THEIR CROSS.

To @UN @UNHumanRights @USCIRF @VaticanNews @OpenDoorsUS @acn_int: Turn concern into action. Protect communities. Shelter the displaced. Deliver food and medicine. Investigate atrocities. Rescue the abducted. Hold perpetrators accountable.

I do not ask anyone to abandon prayer. I ask that we understand what our prayers demand of us.

I did not take my oath for glory or recognition. There are things more sacred than my comfort, my safety, even my life.

If my strength can become another man's shelter, my courage his hope, my voice his defense, or my life the price of his tomorrow, then none of it was ever mine to keep.

When Almighty God asks what we did while His children suffered, may our answer be greater than, “Lord, we watched, and we prayed.”

WE MUST BECOME THE ANSWER TO SOMEONE ELSE'S PRAYER.

text:
The Storm Beats Upon Both Houses
Psalm 30 A Psalm and Song at the dedication of the house of David.

David is a great type of the Lord Jesus Christ. At times the Lord uses the name David but Christ is in view:

Ezekiel 34:23 And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.
 Psalm 30's inscription: "dedication of the house of David" is spiritually pointing to Christ. It is a psalm given for the dedication of Christ's house.

David had wanted to build the Lord a house. But God refused him and said to David:

1 Chronicles 17:10 ...Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house. 11 And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom. 12 He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.
 God would build David (Christ) a house. And His throne would be established forever (an eternal throne can only refer to the throne of Christ). 
 Solomon thought that the physical house of God (temple) he was building was the fulfillment of the promise given to his father. But it was only an illustration of the house the Seed of David would build.

In the N.T. many references to Jesus as being the Son of David indicate He was the promised Messiah. These verses in the gospel of Luke especially match up well with the things God said to David in 1 Chronicles 17:
Luke 1:31 And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS. 32 He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David: 33 And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
 SPIRITUAL HOUSE

The Bible plainly tells us that Jesus was indeed building a spiritual house made up of all those He would save:

1 Peter 2:5 Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house,...

And,

Hebrews 3:4 For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God. 5 And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after; 6 But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we,
Throughout time, since the fall of man into sin, the Lord was building His spiritual house. The house of David His Shepherd (Christ).
It is this spiritual house comprised of all that God has saved that is in view in this parable:

Matthew 7:24 Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock: 25 And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.

Jesus is the Wise man that built His house upon a Rock (Himself). The house is able to weather the storm because of the solid foundation.

(Note: the spiritual house of God was builded upon the foundation of the Lord Jesus' sacrificial offering of Himself. Every time God saved a person it was as though He were adding a another living brick to that house. And since all is built upon Christ it must mean that the foundation was the first thing laid. Christ necessarily had to have died from the foundation of the world to first lay the foundation for all the living stones that would be laid upon it over the course of history. In other words: the fact that the Bible says God built a spiritual house and Jesus is the foundation of the house all must have been built upon proves that Christ truly was the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world. The Rock for the house was laid at that point. Then men could be saved and built upon the foundation. Abel was saved and added to the foundation of Christ. Noah was saved and added as a living stone. Etc, etc.)

DEDICATION ONCE HOUSE IS COMPLETED
Once again we know the Bible reveals Christ was building Himself a spiritual house for an eternal habitation. The historical building of the house of God by Solomon pictures the spiritual house. After several years the house Solomon built was finally finished. The Bible tells us that when it was completed it would be dedicated:

1 Kings 8:63 And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto the LORD, two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD.
 2 Chronicles 7:5 And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.
 The finished temple is a wonderful historical illustration of the time that would come when God would finish building His spiritual house. At the time of the end the Bible reveals that a great multitude would become saved and come out of the great tribulation period (Revelation 7:9-14). At that point the last of the elect whose names were written in the Lamb's book of life would have been found and saved through the sending forth of the gospel into the world. On May 21, 2011 the great tribulation ended. And therefore the great multitude had been saved. The spiritual house of Christ was completed. For the first time in all the world's history it could be said that the house the Lord Jesus Christ was building was now fully built and established.

LAW FOR LEAVING THE BATTLE IN ORDER TO DEDICATE HOUSE

The Bible is an amazing book. It has written in it relatively obscure and often unusual laws that we read as part of the law of God without fully realizing why they are even in the Bible. One such unusual law is found in the book of Deuteronomy:

Deuteronomy 20:4 For the LORD your God is he that goeth with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you. 5 And the officers shall speak unto the people, saying, What man is there that hath built a new house, and hath not dedicated it? let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man dedicate it.
 Deuteronomy 20 gives several battle (war) laws. One of the laws described says that a man that has built a new house without dedicating it may leave the battle and go home to his house to dedicate it. An interesting law, certainly the Lord carefully considers the soldiers' personal life to be an important thing. But since this is the Bible we have to ask the question: why is this law recorded in the holy Scriptures? What is its spiritual significance?

Well, once we consider that the Bible says God is a man of war (Exodus 15:3) and the Hebrew word for "war" is the same word translated as 'battle' in this Deuteronomy 20 passage, we quickly see that this law has application to God Himself.

Actually, Deuteronomy 20:4 says God fights (in the battle) in order to save you:

"...fight for you against your enemies, to save you."

This is exactly what the Lord has been doing throughout the course of this world's history. He has engaged the kingdom of darkness in spiritual warfare in order to deliver His elect people out of their dungeons to sin and Satan:

Revelation 6:2 And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.
 Yes God is a man of battle! But the Lord made an allowance through this law in Deuteronomy 20:5 that once a house is newly built, the man of war may leave the battle and go home to dedicate the house. Since the battle God fought in was to "save you" we can quickly see the spiritual principle: as soon as house of the elect is completed the Lord will cease to engage the enemy in spiritual warfare (over the salvation of souls). There is no longer any purpose for God to send forth the gospel to save since everyone to be saved has been saved. Deuteronomy 20:4,5, teaches us that a newly built house and its dedication ties in with the end of the salvation.

BUILT UPON A ROCK

We find something interesting as we return to the parable of the wise man and the house that he built:

Matthew 7:24 Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock: 25 And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.

Again, the wise man is a picture of Christ. The house is the spiritual house of the elect. And the Rock is also Christ. Notice that the house is said to have been built. It does not say it is in building. The idea presented is not a house under construction. Or that is being added to in any way. But a completed house. It is built. The same Greek word is found used in:

Acts 7:47 But Solomon built him an house.

The Greek word for "built" above is the identical Greek word (and tense) as used in Matthew 7:24. Solomon built him an house is referring to a past event. Solomon built God a house some thousand years earlier than the writing of the book of Acts. Likewise, the wise man (Christ) built his house (whose house are we) upon a Rock (Christ). In order for the house to be completely done it must mean that everyone predestinated to salvation has heard the gospel and has been saved. Only then can it be said that the house is built.

But when will God save the last of the elect and complete His house? The Bible reveals to us that this was accomplished by the date of May 21, 2011. That is the first time in all the history of the world that it could be said that the spiritual house of the Lord Jesus Christ was built.

THE STORM COMES

I have read the short, little parable of the wise man that built his house upon a rock many times before. And yet, never realized its great significance. Through this parable Christ is instructing us concerning what to expect once the house of God is completed:

Matthew 7:25 And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.

The context of Matthew 7 which leads us into the parable of the wise man and his house points us to the Day of Judgment:

Matthew 7:22 Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works? 23 And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.

Many will say "IN THAT DAY Lord, Lord, ..." We quickly see how this ties in with another important passage of Scripture:

Luke 13:25 When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:
 The time period of those that say: "Lord, Lord" is the time when the door of heaven shuts. And the Bible has locked in the day of May 21, 2011 as the day God shut heaven's door. That's the context of Matthew 7 that leads us directly into the parable of the wise man that built his house on a rock. And it so happens that the Bible insists that the spiritual house of Christ (whose house are we) was completed by the date of May 21, 2011. God sent forth His Word into all the world in an unprecedented manner---never before in all the world's history had a message like the message of Judgment Day occurring on an appointed time been proclaimed and set forth before the forefront of the world's eyes as it was with the declaration of May 21, 2011. Through that worldwide proclamation the Lord saved a great multitude. The last one of the elect became saved sometime before the great tribulation period expired. But then the 8400th day of the great tribulation came and the spiritual structure of God's elect was then completely built. It was then time for God to bring the storm against the house.

STORM BEATS UPON BOTH HOUSES
We haven't discussed the other house mentioned in Matthew 7's parable. It is interesting that God describes a storm that assails BOTH houses. The house of the wise man (Christ) and the house of the foolish man. Both houses experience the identical storm:
Storm beats upon the wise man's house:

Matthew 7:24 Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock: 25 And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.

Storm beats upon foolish man's house:

Matthew 7:26 And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand: 27 And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.

One of the biggest problems some believers have with understanding the idea of May 21, 2011 being the day in which a spiritual judgment began on the world, is the fact that the elect were not taken out of the world before the judgment started. It has been widely taught in the churches, by the reformers, and many others, that God's elect will be raptured prior to the judgment that comes upon the unsaved of the world. But as is the case with many other things we have learned since the Lord unsealed His Word the Bible, the Bible teaches something totally different. The Bible teaches that the elect will indeed be upon the earth and living in the world during the Day of Judgment. The parable of the wise man and foolish man that built their houses before the storm came is another proof text that shows us that it has been God's plan all along to leave those He saved in the world to weather the storm of His wrath.

As soon as God newly built His spiritual house He immediately sent the storm of His judgment against it. I'm sure that if you are one of God's elect you have felt the severe trying of your Christian life in these days after the tribulation (since May 21, 2011). There is good reason for all your afflictions, tribulations, struggles, and difficulties that you have certainly been experiencing in one way or another. It is the trial of the house. By the conclusion of this Day of Judgment the foundation of each one of us will be revealed.

THE HOUSE OF THE RIGHTEOUS SHALL STAND
The book of Proverbs says,

Proverbs 12:7 The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.

As we think about the two houses in Matthew 7's parable we can see exactly what this proverb is saying. Christ is the Righteous One. The house He built will stand. The house of God's elect will come through the storm. They will endure to the end of this period of Judgment Day. The house of the foolish will not withstand the storm. The storm will destroy their house and overthrow it. And at the end they will be annihilated and no longer have existence.

The wicked cannot stand (endure) before God.

Psalm 1:4 The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away. 5 Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

Revelation 6:17 For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?

Malachi 3:2 But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth? for he is like a refiner's fire, and like fullers' soap:

But the child of God. The individual that is a living stone and thereby a part of Christ's house (the house of the righteous) shall stand through the storm of God's judgment:

Ephesians 6:13 Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

Luke 21:35 For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.
 36 Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.

Romans 14:10 But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
TO GOD BE THE GLORY

We often hear people say that there is no reason for God to have left His people in the world to go through the final judgment. They say it serves no purpose. And yet as we examine the parable of the wise man that built his house upon a rock, we see a very important truth shine forth: as both houses suffer the effects of the storm something glorious is finally revealed.

Luke 6:47 Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like: 48 He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock. 49 But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.

And,

Matthew 7:25 And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
 26 And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
 27 And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
 Why did one house stand and the other fall? Was it due to the timber used to build the house? Or was it the strong bricks that allowed the house to resist the power of the storm? No! It had nothing to do with the materials used. It is clear that the wise man's house endured the storm and the foolish man's house did not for one reason only----it was built upon a Rock. The powerful storm reveals the type of foundation each house was built upon. Likewise, this most powerful and awful storm of the pouring out of the wrath of God upon all the inhabitants of the earth, in the Day of Judgment reveals what (or who) each person's foundation truly is.

1 Corinthians 3:9 For we are labourers together with God: ye are God's husbandry, ye are God's building. 10 According to the grace of God which is given unto me, as a wise masterbuilder, I have laid the foundation, and another buildeth thereon. But let every man take heed how he buildeth thereupon. 11 For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ. 12 Now if any man build upon this foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, stubble; 13 Every man's work shall be made manifest: for the day shall declare it, because it shall be revealed by fire; and the fire shall try every man's work of what sort it is. 14 If any man's work abide which he hath built thereupon, he shall receive a reward. 15 If any man's work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire.
 At the end of this prolonged period of Judgment Day, God's people will have endured and remain standing together in the spiritual house Christ built.

Hebrews 12:26 Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven. 27 And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain. 28 Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear: 29 For our God is a consuming fire.

text:
U.S. firm Cummings Aerospace has fired two 3D-printed Hellhound S3 jet drones from a launcher on a utility vehicle, Defence Blog reported. One operator controlled both from a single handheld system.

The test was on 25 August at the Pendleton UAS Range in Oregon. Results were announced on 12 October. Both flew inert payloads on separate routes. It was the first vehicle launch, the first use of an eight-round launcher, the first ripple-fire and the first time one operator ran more than one Hellhound.

The S3 is baseball-bat sized, about 6 kilograms (13 pounds), flies more than 60 kilometres (37 miles) at up to 618 km/h (384 mph). 3D-printed and commercial parts. Production more than 100 a month. Modules for armour-piercing, blast, electronic warfare and decoy swap in under two minutes. CEO Sheila Cummings said one soldier can put multiple Hellhounds on multiple targets. A larger S4 is offered for Golden Dome. 

No order was announced.

Source: Defence Blog

text:
CARDANO, LEIOS & MIDNIGHT: A MUCH BIGGER STORY THAN ADA SCALABILITY
Cardano is developing an interconnected financial infrastructure combining scalability, programmable privacy, decentralized security, and distinct economic models.
The tech worth understanding are Ouroboros Leios, Cardano (ADA), Midnight (NIGHT), and DUST.
And their roles are very different.
1. OUROBOROS LEIOS —> EXPANDING CARDANO'S CAPACITY..
Leios is a major evolution of Cardano's Ouroboros proof-of-stake consensus protocol.
Its innovation is separating transaction processing from the main blockchain's sequential block-production constraints.
Rather than relying exclusively on traditional Praos blocks, Leios introduces endorser blocks that allow transactions to be processed in parallel, validated through stake-weighted voting, and incorporated into the ledger through certification.

The numbers are significant:
Public MusashiNet testing demonstrated approx 6× Cardano's existing maximum throughput capacity.
Peak throughput reached 26.8 transaction kilobytes per second, compared with a 4.51 TxkB/s Praos mainnet ceiling.
The public testing program involved 63 registered stake pools.
The project's current stated initial scaling objective is approximately 5–20× throughput, subject to successful testing and deployment.
This is not merely a theoretical white paper. Public testing is underway, although production readiness and mainnet performance remain unproven.

Why does this matter?
A blockchain supporting millions of users, stablecoin payments, tokenized securities, automated settlements, and decentralized applications must have sufficient capacity to handle sustained transaction demand.
Leios addresses the infrastructure bottleneck, not just the headline TPS figure.

2. MIDNIGHT —>THE MISSING PRIVACY LAYER FOR REAL-WORLD FINANCE
Public blockchains offer transparency, but transparency creates challenges for financial institutions.
Consider banks, healthcare organizations, investment managers, and corporations.
They cannot expose every customer's identity, transaction details, proprietary strategy, or confidential financial records on a public ledger.
Yet they must also demonstrate compliance, auditability, and transaction validity.
This is precisely the problem Midnight is designed to address.
Midnight is a separate, privacy-focused partner blockchain associated with Cardano.
It uses zero-knowledge proofs, selective disclosure, and a dual-state architecture to allow applications to combine public verification with confidential information.

For example:
An investor could prove eligibility to participate in a regulated investment without publicly exposing their complete identity or financial information.
A business could validate a contractual condition without revealing commercially sensitive data.
A financial application could maintain private records while selectively disclosing information to authorized parties.

Midnight's Compact programming language enables developers to specify which information remains private and which information becomes publicly verifiable.
The distinction is crucial: Midnight is not designed to make everything invisible. It is designed to make privacy programmable.

3. NIGHT AND DUST —> A DIFFERENT ECONOMIC ARCHITECTURE
Midnight also introduces an unusual token-resource model.
NIGHT is its transferable utility token, with a fixed total supply of 24 billion.
Holding and registering NIGHT generates DUST, the resource used to execute transactions and smart contracts on Midnight.
DUST is not another speculative cryptocurrency.
It is non-transferable, consumed through network usage, and designed to regenerate over time while supported by registered NIGHT.
Under the published model:
1 NIGHT can generate a maximum capacity of 5 DUST.
Full capacity develops over approximately one week.
Consumed DUST can regenerate while NIGHT remains registered.
DUST is designed to reduce exposure to volatile transaction-fee pricing.
Why is this interesting?
Traditional blockchain applications often require users to purchase a volatile native asset whenever they want to transact.
Midnight separates ownership of the underlying token from consumption of network capacity.

For enterprises processing large volumes of transactions, this could make operational costs more predictable.
NIGHT provides the economic resource base. DUST powers network execution.

4. WHERE ADA FITS INTO THE EQUATION
ADA is Cardano's native asset and plays a different role.
It supports Cardano's proof-of-stake consensus, staking rewards, governance, transaction fees, and ecosystem liquidity.
Leios strengthens Cardano's potential capacity to support additional applications and transaction volume.
Midnight adds specialized privacy capabilities alongside Cardano, rather than replacing Cardano or making ADA obsolete.
There is already a concrete technical connection:
NIGHT holders on Cardano can register their tokens to generate DUST on Midnight without transferring the underlying NIGHT.
That registration requires a Cardano transaction and therefore an ADA network fee.
However, Midnight executes its own transactions independently. It would be incorrect to suggest every Midnight transaction automatically creates an ADA fee.
The longer-term opportunity for ADA is broader ecosystem activity, liquidity, application development, and cross-chain integration.
ADA secures and powers Cardano. NIGHT underpins Midnight's resource economy. DUST enables Midnight transactions. Leios expands Cardano's throughput.
5. HOW THIS COULD APPLY TO TOKENIZED WALL STREET
Consider a hypothetical regulated platform offering tokenized Treasury securities, investment funds, and fractional real estate ownership.
A scalable public network could support token transfers, asset records, and settlement activity.
A privacy-focused network could protect investor identities, confidential commercial information, and sensitive compliance data.
Zero-knowledge proofs could establish that certain requirements have been satisfied without publishing the underlying records.
Smart contracts could automate approved transfers, distributions, and compliance conditions.
The combination becomes especially interesting for:
Tokenized securities: Ownership transfers with privacy-preserving investor eligibility checks.
Institutional collateral: Programmable collateral management with selective disclosure of sensitive positions.
Real estate tokenization: Fractional ownership, investor verification, and automated distributions.
Healthcare and digital identity: Verification of sensitive attributes without publicly disclosing entire records.
AI-driven finance: Automated transactions with programmable permissions and confidential business information.
These are potential use cases, not evidence that Wall Street institutions have committed to deploying these workflows on Cardano or Midnight.

6. THE INVESTMENT THESIS: ADA VS. NIGHT
This is where investors need to distinguish technology from token economics.
ADA's opportunity is tied to Cardano becoming a more widely used settlement, application, and financial infrastructure network.
If Leios attracts meaningful activity, ADA could benefit from increased transaction demand, liquidity, staking participation, and ecosystem development.
NIGHT's opportunity is tied more directly to demand for Midnight's privacy-preserving applications and the DUST capacity needed to operate them.

If applications require substantial recurring network capacity, holding NIGHT to generate DUST could become economically useful.
But neither token is guaranteed to appreciate simply because the technology succeeds.
The key questions are whether applications attract users, whether institutions deploy meaningful capital, and whether demand produces sustainable economic value.

7. WHAT I AM WATCHING NEXT
The most important developments are Leios security testing and mainnet readiness, Midnight's adoption of privacy-preserving smart contracts, cross-chain interoperability, actual DUST utilization, and measurable increases in Cardano network activity.
The objective should not be to win a blockchain popularity contest.
It should be to build infrastructure capable of supporting real financial activity at scale.
THE BIGGER PICTURE
LEIOS —> Scalability
CARDANO / ADA —> Decentralized Security, Governance & Economic Infrastructure
MIDNIGHT —> Programmable Privacy & Selective Disclosure
NIGHT —> Midnight's Utility Token & Capacity Generation
DUST —> Transaction Execution Resource
Together, these technologies represent an ambitious attempt to combine the openness of public blockchains with some of the confidentiality and operational requirements of regulated finance.
My central question isn't how fast ADA can move in price. It's whether Cardano and Midnight can become useful infrastructure for the next generation of financial markets.
Because sustainable value ultimately comes from real adoption—>not speculation alone.

text:
In China, a man can die single and still get married.

The bride is now built in a factory.

And the strangest part is not the doll. It is why a family would spend more on her than on the funeral.

Read this slowly. By the end you will not be sure whether you just read about death, love, or manufacturing.

Because it is all three. And it is far bigger than it looks.

Let me take it apart.

1. THE WEDDING THAT STARTS AFTER THE DEATH

Chinese has a term for it: minghun. Spirit marriage. Ghost marriage.

It is not a metaphor. It is a contract, a ceremony, a negotiation, and in some places a market.

The record goes back thousands of years. One of the most quoted cases comes from the third century. A warlord named Cao Cao lost a young son, Cao Chong, who died at around thirteen. The grieving father did not just bury the boy. He arranged a marriage for him, with a girl from another family who had also died young.

The chroniclers wrote it down without a flicker of embarrassment. The most powerful man in northern China spent political capital on the love life of a dead child.

That is the first thing to understand. This is not a fringe superstition invented by the internet. It is one of the oldest social technologies on the continent, and it has outlived dynasties, republics, a revolution, and a state that officially discourages it.

Why does it survive?

Because it solves a problem that logic cannot touch.

2. THE PROBLEM IT SOLVES

In traditional belief, a person is not finished when the heart stops. A person becomes an ancestor. Ancestors need a place in the family line, offerings, a name on the tablet, someone to remember them on the right days.

An unmarried adult breaks that system.

No spouse. No children. No one to carry incense forward. In the old model, that spirit is not at peace. It is a loose end in the family tree, and loose ends do not stay quiet. They bring bad luck, illness, a failed harvest, a run of terrible years.

So the family does what any practical family does with an unresolved liability.

They close it.

They find a partner for the dead.

Notice what this really is. It is not romance. It is risk management dressed in red silk. It is insurance against the unseen, paid in the only currencies the living have: money, ritual, and attention.

And once you see it as insurance, the next question gets uncomfortable.

If the bride is a transaction, what exactly is being bought?

3. A MARKET NO ONE ADMITS EXISTS

For centuries the arrangement was simple. Two families, each with a dead child, agreed to a match. Matchmakers carried the proposals. Astrology was consulted. Gifts changed hands. The two were buried together, or their remains were joined.

Then the numbers broke it.

Decades of a strong preference for sons, combined with the one-child era, left China with tens of millions more men than women in the younger generations. Demographers have put the surplus at roughly thirty million. That is not a rounding error. That is the population of a mid-sized country, standing in line for a partner who does not exist.

Now the living men are priced out of marriage. Bride prices in some regions climbed so high that a wedding became a decade of family savings. Plenty of men simply never marry.

And when those men die, their families face the old problem with a new twist.

There are not enough brides for the living.

There are certainly not enough for the dead.

So supply found its way in, and it was dark. Over the years there were reports and court cases of graves being robbed, of bodies stolen and sold to families who needed a bride, of prices climbing into the tens of thousands of yuan and beyond. Authorities treat trading in corpses as a crime. Prosecutions happened. Headlines happened. The market did not vanish, it went underground, which is where markets go when they are both illegal and wanted.

Think about that structure for a second.

A deep cultural need.

A shortage created by demographics.

A black market created by the shortage.

A moral catastrophe created by the black market.

Every one of those is the kind of problem that, sooner or later, somebody tries to solve with engineering.

4. THE PIVOT

Here is where the story turns.

What if the bride did not have to come from a grave?

What if she could be manufactured, on demand, in a size, a face, and a skin tone the family chooses, with no crime in the supply chain and no family on the other side to negotiate with?

That is the idea. And it is not as crazy as it sounds, because the industry that can deliver it already exists.

It was never built for funerals. It was built for something else entirely. But the capability is the capability, and a family with a dead son and a budget does not care about the original use case.

This is how most technology actually spreads. Not through a keynote. Through a quiet repurposing, in a corner of the economy where somebody has a problem and somebody else has a part that fits.

So let's talk about the part.

5. HOW A FACE BECOMES BELIEVABLE

Almost nobody understands how hard this is.

A realistic human figure is not a mannequin with better paint. It is a stack of disciplines that normally live in different industries.

Start with the skeleton. Inside the body there is an articulated metal frame, with joints designed to move through a human range of motion and hold a pose without drooping. Engineers argue about the geometry of a shoulder for weeks, because a shoulder that rotates wrong is the first thing your eye catches and the last thing your brain forgives.

Over the frame goes the flesh. Not one material. Layers. A softer, denser body that has the weight and the give of tissue, and a finer outer skin that takes light the way skin does. Medical-grade silicone and thermoplastic elastomer are the two big families. One is premium and costs a lot more. The other is cheaper and more forgiving. The difference you feel when you touch them is the difference between a handshake and a handshake with a glove on.

Then comes the face, which is where the real money and the real time go.

A face is cast from a sculpt. The sculpt is made by an artist who spends days on eyelids alone. Eyes are not painted flat. They are layered, with depth in the iris, a wet highlight in the corner, a faint red in the inner lid that nobody consciously notices and everybody subconsciously requires.

Hair is not a wig glued to a scalp. In the better products, strands are implanted individually, one at a time, by hand, with a needle. Eyebrows too. Lashes too. We are talking thousands of insertions on a single head.

Then the paint. Capillaries on the cheeks. A faint blush at the knuckles. Shadows under the eyes. Subtle variation on the lips, because real lips are not one colour.

The result weighs about as much as a small adult. It is heavy. It is cold until warmed. And it sits at a precise point on a curve that roboticists have been staring at since 1970.

6. THE CURVE THAT RUNS THE WHOLE INDUSTRY

In 1970 a Japanese roboticist named Masahiro Mori published a short essay with a very simple claim.

As something becomes more human-like, our affection for it rises.

Then, just before it becomes perfectly human, affection collapses into unease. A strange, cold revulsion. Then, if the imitation becomes perfect, the feeling returns and climbs.

He called the dip the uncanny valley.

Everything about this industry is a negotiation with that valley. Designers are not trying to make something that looks alive. They are trying to make something that does not trigger the alarm that tells you it is almost alive.

That alarm is ancient. Researchers suggest it evolved to protect us from things that look like people and are not: corpses, the sick, the contagious. Your brain is running a tiny, constant health check on every face it sees, and the valley is what happens when that check returns an error.

Now sit with the irony.

A product built to cross the valley from the living side is being used, in this context, to represent someone on the other side of it.

The thing you are trying to avoid feeling is the thing the ritual is about.

7. WHAT THE FAMILY IS ACTUALLY PAYING FOR

Ask a family why they do this and the answers are almost never technical.

They do not say "high-fidelity silicone."

They say things like: he should not be alone.

They say: my mother cannot sleep.

They say: the villagers will talk.

They say: it is what we do.

Look at what is on that list. Loneliness. Guilt. Reputation. Tradition. Four of the heaviest forces in human life, and not one of them is about the object.

The object is a container. What the family buys is a closed loop. The dead son has a partner. The mother has done her duty. The village has seen it done correctly. The ancestors have no reason to complain.

That is a product. And like every great product, it is not really a product at all. It is a feeling the customer could not get any other way.

The technology is not the point.

The technology is what makes the point affordable.

8. THE NUMBERS THAT MAKE IT ALMOST INEVITABLE

Let's do the arithmetic, because arithmetic is where this stops being a curiosity and starts being a market.

A traditional funeral in many Chinese regions is a serious expense. A traditional wedding, with bride price, banquet, gifts, and the home that comes with it, is a bigger one, often several times the annual income of the family.

A spirit marriage through the old channels, with a real corpse, carried legal risk, social risk, and a price tag that could spiral on the black market.

A manufactured bride can cost a fraction of the high end of that range. It can be ordered. It can be delivered. It can be customised. It can be repaired. It breaks no law of the dead.

Run it as a business case.

Demand: a deep cultural need, repeated every time an unmarried young man dies.

Supply: factories that already know how to make the product.

Regulatory risk: lower than the alternative.

Margin: you are selling emotional closure. You can charge for that.

If a founder pitched this to a room of investors without the cultural context, they would call it a niche. If they pitched it with the demographics, they would call it a category.

The demographics are real. The category is real. And almost no one in the Western tech world is paying attention to it.

9. THE OBJECTION YOU ARE ALREADY THINKING

At this point a reasonable person asks: is this right?

It is a fair question. Let me give you the strongest case on both sides, because the weak versions of both are boring.

THE CASE AGAINST

The dead cannot consent. Neither the man nor the bride.

The living are using a ritual to manage their own anxiety, and presenting it as a gift to someone who can no longer receive it.

Turning the ritual into a purchase risks hollowing it out. A ceremony that once demanded a real match, a real negotiation, a real act of community, can now be completed with a credit card and a courier.

It can also deepen a pattern of treating women as objects, literally and figuratively, in a country already living with the consequences of a gender imbalance.

And there is a darker edge. Any product that makes a harmful practice cheaper may increase the demand for the practice.

THE CASE FOR

The family is real. The grief is real. The mother who cannot sleep is real.

The alternative, for a long time, was a corpse market that involved grave robbery and sometimes violence. Replacing a crime with a manufactured object is, in a narrow way, a net reduction in harm.

Rituals have always used symbols. A ring is a piece of metal. A flag is a piece of cloth. A wafer is a piece of bread. The object is never the point. The meaning is assigned by the people who need it.

And the dead, in the logic of the tradition, are not harmed. They are accommodated.

If you hold both of those thoughts at once and neither one cancels the other, you are not confused. You are paying attention.

10. THE WEST IS NOT EXEMPT

Before you feel superior, look at what the rest of the world is doing with the same instinct.

In 2021, a man named Joshua Barbeau used an experimental text-generation tool to simulate his fiancee, who had died years earlier. He fed it her old messages and a few lines of personality. It answered back. He talked to it for hours. The story was widely reported, and it landed because every reader recognised the impulse.

In 2012 a hologram of Tupac Shakur performed at a festival in California, years after his death. The crowd screamed. The technology did not matter. The feeling did.

Companies now offer to compress cremated remains into a diamond. Others promise to freeze a body in the hope of future revival. Others build chatbots trained on a loved one's voice. Researchers at Cambridge have warned about so-called deadbots and the risk of companies exploiting grief.

In Japan, a man named Akihiko Kondo held a wedding in 2018 with a holographic character. He was alive. The partner was software. He said he was happy, and he was not performing it for a camera.

Put these next to each other.

A silicone bride in a village. A chatbot of a lost fiancee. A hologram on a stage. A diamond made from ashes. A marriage to a program.

Different continents. Different budgets. Different decades.

One impulse.

We cannot stand the idea that a relationship simply ends. And every society, with whatever tools it has, builds something to hold the door open.

11. WHY YOU CANNOT LOOK AWAY

This is the reason that this subject spreads.

It does not just surprise you. It makes you check your own position.

You think the idea is disturbing. Fine. Ask yourself why.

Is it because the bride is manufactured? You wear glasses to correct your eyes. You carry a phone that remembers your relatives' birthdays. You may have a cloud folder with ten thousand photos of someone who is gone.

Is it because the groom is dead? You visit graves. You light candles. You speak out loud to people who cannot hear.

Is it because money is involved? You have paid for a funeral, a headstone, a flower arrangement, a plot of land to hold a body.

Every element of this ritual has a cousin in your own life. You are just used to yours.

That is why it hits. It is not alien. It is familiar, pushed past the line where you can pretend it is normal.

12. THE QUIET QUESTION UNDER ALL OF THIS

If you have read this far, here is where it stops being about China.

What do we owe the people we lose?

A grave? A memory? A name on the wall? A hologram? A conversation with a machine that sounds like them?

And what do we owe the people who are still here, and who need to see the debt paid in a form they can understand?

Every culture answers differently. None of them answers fully. And every answer is shaped by the tools that culture happens to have at the moment it asks.

Today, those tools have changed.

The same factories that make lifelike figures can now make them cheaper, lighter, and more expressive. The same labs that train language models can give a face a voice. The same sensors that let a phone unlock with your face can let a figure follow your gaze.

Put those curves together and the question stops being whether a family will ever be able to buy a presence for someone who is gone.

It becomes how convincing that presence is allowed to be.

And who gets to decide when it is too much.

13. THE PART WHERE THE LINE MOVES

Here is the forecast no one wants to say out loud.

Today the figure lies still. Eyes fixed. Hands arranged.

Tomorrow it may breathe, just faintly. Because a slow, subtle chest movement is the cheapest trick in the book, and it changes how the body is perceived more than any extra pound of silicone.

Then the eyes track. Then the voice answers. Then the face learns which expressions make the family feel better, and does more of them.

At that point you are no longer looking at a ceremonial object. You are looking at a companion with a fixed role and an infinitely adjustable personality.

That raises the oldest question in the field.

If it responds to you, and comforts you, and remembers what you told it, at what point does the fact that it is not alive stop mattering to you?

The honest answer: for many people, much sooner than they expect.

We already know this from a thousand small experiments. People name their cars. People thank voice assistants. People grieve when a robot vacuum dies. The human mind does not wait for permission before it assigns a soul.

The industry is not trying to trick anyone. It does not need to. It only needs to be good enough that the brain does the rest.

14. WHO BENEFITS, WHO PAYS

Every technology has an invoice. Let's read this one.

THE LIVING FAMILY gets relief. A closed loop, a settled mind, a ritual completed.

THE INDUSTRY gets a customer segment it never planned for, and a story that stops being embarrassing as soon as you put the word "tradition" next to it.

THE BLACK MARKET loses a product line. That is a genuine benefit, and it is rarely mentioned.

THE WIDER CULTURE gets a mirror. One that shows how far a society will go to avoid leaving a story unfinished.

And who pays?

Possibly the women who are quietly commodified in all of this, whether as bodies, as brides, or as faces that must be perfect for a ritual they never chose.

Possibly the living bachelors, who watch a spare fortune spent on a wedding for the dead while they cannot afford one of their own.

Possibly the dead themselves, if you believe they have any stake in how they are remembered.

Possibly all of us, if we let a cheap simulation quietly replace the harder work of sitting with loss.

A technology is never just a tool. It is a decision about what we are willing to make easier.

15. THE LESSON FOR ANYONE BUILDING ANYTHING

Forget the ritual for a moment. Look at the pattern, because it repeats in every industry.

LESSON ONE. The biggest markets are usually emotional needs wearing the costume of a practical product. Nobody buys a spirit bride for the silicone. They buy peace.

LESSON TWO. Capability spreads sideways. Technology built for one purpose finds its second life in a use the original engineers never imagined. If you want to find the next big thing, do not look at what is new. Look at what existing capability is waiting for a problem.

LESSON THREE. Scarcity creates ugly markets, and good engineering can retire them. Whenever a black market exists, there is a gap that a clean alternative can fill. Ethics and economics sometimes point the same direction.

LESSON FOUR. Culture is a stronger force than technology. Silicone figures sit in warehouses around the world. Only where a deep tradition meets a real demographic squeeze does one become a bride.

LESSON FIVE. The line between tool and companion is thinner than we like to admit. Build accordingly.

If you work in products, ask which of these five is operating in your own market right now. Odds are, at least two.

16. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

I will make three predictions. Hold me to them.

PREDICTION ONE. The practice will not disappear. Younger generations will question it, and many will refuse it. But as long as unmarried men die and families fear for their spirits, someone will meet the demand. The only open question is whether it is met by a grave robber or a factory.

PREDICTION TWO. The figures will get better, much faster than the public conversation about them. The leap from still to responsive is a software problem, and software problems move at a speed that regulators and ethicists cannot match.

PREDICTION THREE. This will stop being only a Chinese story. The impulse is universal. Aging societies, falling marriage rates, rising loneliness, and cheap realistic embodiment are not unique to one country. When the same forces line up elsewhere, the same products will appear, under different names and with different rituals attached.

I am not saying that is good.

I am saying that if you are surprised when it arrives, you did not read the numbers.

17. WHY THE INTERNET CANNOT SCROLL PAST IT

There is a reason this kind of story stops a thumb in motion.

It breaks three rules at once.

Rule one: death is supposed to be private. Here it is staged, dressed, and ceremonial.

Rule two: love is supposed to be mutual. Here it is arranged, one-sided, and eternal.

Rule three: technology is supposed to be about the future. Here it is serving the oldest fear in the past.

When a single scene violates all three, the brain does not file it. It holds it open, trying to resolve the contradiction. That is the hook. Not the shock. The unresolved tension.

Every great piece of content works the same way. It gives you a question you cannot answer in one second, and then it makes you want to stay for the answer.

Notice that you did.

Notice, too, that at no point did anyone need to be told what to feel. The facts were enough. Demographics. Tradition. Craft. Grief. Arrange them in the right order and the emotion arrives by itself.

That is the difference between content that informs and content that sticks.

18. SEVEN QUESTIONS TO ASK ABOUT ANY STRANGE RITUAL

Next time you meet a custom that makes you flinch, run this checklist before you judge it.

One. What fear is it managing?
Two. Who carries the cost, and who collects the benefit?
Three. What was the older version of it, and what broke that version?
Four. Which technology made the new version possible?
Five. Is there a cleaner alternative, or only a more comfortable one?
Six. What is the closest thing in my own culture?
Seven. If I were inside it, grieving, with a village watching, would I really choose differently?

Most hot takes die at question six.

One more thing before the close.

Notice how quickly your own opinion formed while reading. Somewhere around section three you had a verdict. Somewhere around section ten it started to wobble.

That wobble is the most honest reaction available. It means the subject is bigger than your first answer.

Keep it. Most people trade it for certainty within seconds, and certainty is the cheapest thing on the internet.

19. THE UNCOMFORTABLE CLOSE

Let me bring this home.

You can look at all of this and feel disgust. That is allowed.

You can feel pity. That is allowed too.

You can feel curiosity, and a small cold flicker of recognition. That is the one worth keeping.

Because the real subject of this post is not a wedding. It is the oldest negotiation in human history: the one between the person who is gone and the person who is left.

We have been trying to win that negotiation for as long as we have had language. We have tried stone, ink, song, paint, photograph, film, voice recording, and now silicone, code, and light.

Not one of them has ever worked.

And every one of them has been worth trying.

So the next time something looks absurd at first glance, do not just laugh. Ask what pain it is trying to solve. Ask who is paying for the solution. Ask how cheap it is about to get.

Then ask the harder question.

If it were your brother, your son, your friend, and the village was watching, and the tradition was heavy, and the money was there, and the tool was available.

What would you do?

Be honest.

Most people who say they would never are only telling the truth about the version of themselves who has not lost anyone yet.

If this made you think, share it with one person who would argue with you about it. That is the whole point.

And follow for more posts on the places where culture, technology, and grief collide. I publish the ones that are hard to look away from.

P.S. The loudest reply to a post like this is always the same: "this is just weird." Maybe. But weird is simply what an unfamiliar answer to a universal question looks like from the outside. Read the replies. Half of them are people quietly telling you who they lost. Save this. Return to it in a year, after you have lost someone, see if your answer to the final question has changed.

text:
This photograph shows Irish revolutionist and artist Constance Gore-Booth (later Countess Markievicz) sitting on the left and Irish poet and artist Althea Gyles sitting on the right in a London art studio around 1896–1898...

. . . 

In 1898, two young women posed for a photograph inside a London art studio. One would become an artist admired by Oscar Wilde. The other would take up arms against the British Empire, face a death sentence and make political history.

Her name was Constance Gore-Booth, and she had been born into Irish aristocracy.

Raised in privilege, presented at Queen Victoria's court and expected to marry well, Constance seemed destined for a comfortable society life. Instead, she wanted to become an artist.

While studying in London, she occupied a studio belonging to Canadian painter Sophie Pemberton. There, she was photographed alongside Althea Gyles, an unconventional Irish artist whose haunting illustrations became associated with poet W. B. Yeats.

The photograph captures a remarkable moment of freedom. Three women connected through art, independence and a world that offered possibilities beyond marriage and domestic life.

But Constance's future would take a far more dangerous turn.

After marrying a Polish count, she became Countess Markievicz. Increasingly drawn to Irish nationalism and socialism, she abandoned much of her aristocratic lifestyle.

During Dublin's Easter Rising in 1916, she joined the armed rebellion against British rule.

She was captured, court-martialed and sentenced to death. Her sentence was commuted because she was a woman.

Two years later, she became the first woman elected to the British Parliament, although she refused to take her seat.

She died in 1927, aged 59.

Looking at that quiet photograph from 1898, it is almost impossible to imagine what lay ahead.

The young aristocrat who once dreamed of painting would eventually risk her life trying to change the course of Irish history.

Damningly, the official policy was that no foreign leader or British subject was allowed to out-donate the monarch therefore when the Turkish Sultan offered to donate £10,000, British diplomats forced him to slash his donation to £1,000. Which meant in effect that public donations were capped, and more Irish people died, so as not to embarrass Queen Victoria.
Against the backdrop of the unimaginable wealth of the British Empire, a personal donation of £2,000 - while technically making her the largest single individual donor, stands as a glaring symbol of indifference and callous cold-heartedness.
